name: desktop
description: BibleTime — a local-first presentation app for churches and ministries.
author: Anthony Cifuentes

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && pnpm run build && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc src/preload.ts --ignoreConfig --outDir dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --types node && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('dist/preload.js','dist/preload.cjs')"
scripts.package: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
